text:
I understand how frustrating this is after reaching out multiple times. I want to help get this resolved properly.

To assist you best, I need a couple of details:
1. **When was the plant delivered?** (This determines if you're still within the 30-day Plant Care Guarantee, or 90 days if you were a Leafy Plus member when you ordered)
2. **Have you already submitted a claim** through "My Orders" with photos, or is this your first formal claim?

Once I confirm the timeline, I can either process your replacement immediately or, if you're outside the guarantee window, escalate this to a Support Lead—because multiple unanswered contacts suggests something went wrong on our end. You shouldn't have had to chase us three times.
